name: PATH (People Assisting the Homeless)
notes: 2229 S. Yale is the Yale Navigation Center homeless shelter operated by PATH; provides daily meals to residents, not a public recurring food-pantry distribution. No credible public pantry day/time found.

name: Rayo De Luz
notes: Listed as CAPOC/OC Food Bank distribution partner (capoc.org) but no specific day/time published. A 'Rayo de Luz' schedule found online (every other Wed 6-8 PM) is a different location in Bellmead, TX. Not applied.

name: Santa Ana Free Methodist Spanish Church
notes: CAPOC distribution partner (1600 W. Myrtle) with no published recurring day/time.

name: Santa Ana Spanish McFadden DBA of SDA
notes: 117 W. McFadden 7th Day Adventist pantry. Sources conflict (3rd Saturday 2:30-3:30 PM vs every-other-Wednesday 5:30-7 PM vs 2nd/4th Wed 6:30-7 PM) and feedam.org marks hours unconfirmed as of 2026-01-18. Too unreliable to report.

name: SDA Broadway Spanish
notes: 7th Day Adventist Church pantry at 1314 N. Broadway (phone 714-543-3595 matches input). Walk-ins accepted. Listing: 'Every 2nd and 4th Wednesday of the Month 6:30 p.m. - 7:00 p.m.'

name: Serve The People
notes: Confirmed by org site and City of Santa Ana food page: 1st & 3rd Saturday monthly, 4:00-7:00 AM. Free grocery bag + produce; no appointment/pre-registration required. 1206 E. 17th St.

name: Straight Talk Clinic Inc. 'Gerry House'
notes: CAPOC distribution partner (1225/1227 W. 6th St.) but primarily a recovery/counseling clinic; no published recurring food-distribution day/time.

name: Templo Calvario
notes: Runs 'Obras de Amor' food bank and is a CAPOC partner (511 N. Fairview), but no specific recurring distribution day/time published; CDC office hours are Mon-Fri 8:30-5 (not a pantry schedule).

name: Templo Getsemani Assemblies of God
notes: WhyHunger listing for 4822 Hazard Ave shows food pantry Thursday 11 AM-noon and Sunday 1 PM. Only Thursday has a complete time range; Sunday 1 PM lacks an end time so not included in scheduleText. Recommend calling 714-767-2283 to confirm.

name: The Villa Center
notes: 910 N. French is a women's residential recovery program that is a CAPOC food-bank distribution partner; no public recurring pantry day/time published.
